notes.title: Soulrun design decisions & testing
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce, that we've taken big steps along with the development of Soulrun! We now have a playable test version which has been shared with our closed testing group. Once we get the most game-breaking bugs fixed, we will be sharing the test build publicly on Itchio! 

Since we had a hard time to figure out the best controls and best ability combinations for the characters, we decided to make the testing open for all. In the coming build, you can try out all the available abilities and change the character attributes the way you wish!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34624544/3a85b574ce14995aada740da1844ba769b9c2fb2.jpg[/img]
[i]Sneak peek to the work-in-progress testing environment[/i]

We hope to hear a lot of good feedback from everyone to get the best possible controls and most interesting abilities in Soulrun!

Stay tuned and hop into our Discord channel to get involved to the development! https://discord.gg/hdZXeMJ

notes.title: Monsters & Abilities: Work in progress
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

We're happy to announce that Soulrun is closing up closed alpha tests rapidly! Soon everyone who is interested can jump into playing the first version of the game.

The first version will include multiple different monster types, abilities and levels. The length of the gameplay, of course, won't be that long. But you'll sure get an understanding where we're going!

If you're interested in jumping into the closed alpha, make sure to join our Discord channel and drop a message on #gamedev channel to show your interest!

Jestercraft Discord: https://discord.gg/hdZXeMJ

notes.title: FIRST PLAYABLE ALPHA SOON (Join our Discord)
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We're currently working with a first playable alpha version of Soulrun. The alpha version will include a variety of different abilities, the death shop, a couple of monsters and a bunch of different levels with a small number of environmental hazards.

We would love to ask you to assist us, by playing the first alpha when it becomes available. If you're interested in joining the alpha tests, please join our Discord channel and drop a line on the #gaming channel.

https://discord.gg/hdZXeMJ

Hope to see you at our Discord!
